items.text: The first self-hosted release, v0.1.0: a Docker image and a docker-compose bundle that runs Outflare with only Postgres.
Connect your AI: Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and VS Code connect to the hosted MCP server with one URL and a consent screen, with spending off by default.
Projects with briefs, company context and agent memory, and agent missions that wait for your approval.
Mailboxes over Google, Microsoft 365 and SMTP/IMAP, sequences with a policy check on every email, and an inbox that sorts replies.
Site audits: prove you own a site and OutflareBot crawls it, obeying robots.txt and backing off when the site struggles.
The REST API, the TypeScript and Python SDKs, the MCP server and the outflare command line client.
Request logs: every API call in a workspace with status, duration and who made it, with live follow and export.
Connectors with OAuth or your own API keys, including analytics and SEO sources, and outgoing webhooks.
